ACCESS_ROLES.query:
select role_name d, role_id r
from APEX_APPL_ACL_ROLES where application_id = :APP_ID 
order by 1

DESKTOP THEME STYLES.query:
select s.name d,
       s.theme_style_id r
  from apex_application_theme_styles s,
       apex_application_themes t
 where s.application_id = :app_id
   and t.application_id = s.application_id
   and t.theme_number   = s.theme_number
   and t.is_current     = 'Yes'
 order by 1

LOCALE_WFL_ACTIVE_STATUS.query:
SELECT CASE code
 WHEN 'ALL' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'All' END
 WHEN 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Active' END
 ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN ' ' ELSE 'Inactive' END
       END d, code r
FROM (SELECT 'ALL' code,1 seq FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'Y',2 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'N',3 FROM dual)
ORDER BY seq

LOCALE_YN.query:

WFL_WORKFLOW_CATEGORY.query:
SELECT CASE code
 WHEN 'ONBOARDING' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Onboarding' END
 WHEN 'CREDIT_LIMIT' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN ' ' ELSE 'Credit Limit' END
 WHEN 'INVOICE' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Invoice' END
 WHEN 'FUNDING' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Funding' END
 WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Payment' END
 WHEN 'COLLECTION' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Collection' END
 WHEN 'COMPLIANCE' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Compliance' END
 WHEN 'DOCUMENT' THEN CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'Document' END
 ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(:G_LOCALE_CODE,'EN')='AR' THEN '' ELSE 'General' END
       END d, code r
FROM (
 SELECT 'ONBOARDING' code,1 seq FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'CREDIT_LIMIT',2 FROM dual UNION ALL
 SELECT 'INVOICE',3 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'FUNDING',4 FROM dual UNION ALL
 SELECT 'PAYMENT',5 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'COLLECTION',6 FROM dual UNION ALL
 SELECT 'COMPLIANCE',7 FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'DOCUMENT',8 FROM dual UNION ALL
 SELECT 'GENERAL',99 FROM dual
) ORDER BY seq
